summary: Frontend regression after the security hardening (X-User-ID binding + role/scope enforcement on ~66 admin routes + WebSocket auth + SSRF/widget caps). Ran multi-role web smoke: super admin (forest), store manager (qa-manager) and regular rep (mjeast1985). No 401 / 403 was returned to any legitimately authenticated user on any of the tested routes, no session-restore loop, no forced logout. Impersonation start (forest -> Matthew Easton) worked and post-impersonation /home, /contacts, /inbox all loaded clean (0 x 401/403), confirming the token-bound X-User-ID middleware accepts the impersonate_* token as the identity source. Rep hitting admin-only routes directly (/admin/billing, /admin/individuals) correctly gets 403 from backend and the UI renders empty-state / $0 dashboard instead of crashing, which is the expected behavior. One non-auth JS bug found on the store-manager Review Links screen: ReviewLinksScreen crashes with TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'map'). This is NOT caused by the security refactor (no 401/403 on the review-links call) - it is a data-shape bug in the screen (see details below).

ui_bugs.issue: Page crashes with 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading map)' when opened as store manager qa-manager@invalid.imonsocial.test. ErrorBoundary catches it and the screen never renders. loadReviewLinks() sets state directly to response.data from GET /api/admin/users/{user._id}/store-review-links; if the store document has a legacy review_links object missing the 'custom' array, links.custom.map(...) at line 212 throws. Backend default only kicks in when review_links is absent entirely (store.get('review_links', {...defaults})). Fix: normalize response, e.g. setLinks({google:null, yelp:null, facebook:null, dealerrater:null, cars_com:null, custom:[], ...response.data, custom: response.data?.custom || []}).
ui_bugs.priority: MEDIUM (functional bug, unrelated to auth refactor, but blocks Review Links save flow described in the review request)

action_items: Fix ReviewLinksScreen data-shape crash so the qa-manager save flow can be exercised (defensive default for links.custom).

Optional: /admin/team route redirects to /home (no /admin/team screen exists; the actual screen is /admin/manage-team). Not a regression, but review-request line 5 named it as if the route was /admin/team - update the internal link if you want it to be reachable by that path.
critical_code_review_comments: services/api.ts request interceptor sends both Authorization: Bearer <token> and X-User-ID header - good, consistent with new middleware.

bind_identity_header middleware allowlist correctly covers /api/admin/partners/by-slug/* and /api/admin/team/shared-inboxes/{id}/webhook (checked - GET /api/admin/team/shared-inboxes?user_id=<own> still works when bound identity == user_id).
Impersonation token path: impersonate_* Bearer works for /home, /contacts, /inbox with 0 401/403; confirms token->identity binding accepts impersonation prefix.
ReviewLinksScreen defensive coding is weak: setLinks(response.data) with no shape validation - already causing runtime crash today (see ui_bugs).

Regular rep hitting /admin/billing and /admin/individuals: backend correctly returns 403 (Insufficient permissions. Required: super_admin, Your role: user). UI does not surface an access-denied banner, just renders the empty state. Consider a role-guard redirect on the screen so reps do not land on admin pages at all.
